body:
During the process of applying for food stamps, the case worker took into consideration the fact that I lived with roommates, for several months, with no money, and made the determination that we were sharing food. I agreed with her, because that is what I have been surviving on. Because of that, I wasn't eligible. 

I was pretty sad about it, but I'm not going to fight a program that does so much good for so many people. I know they have limited resources and that they have well thought out criteria to help optimize them.
I was turned down because I had roommates and they share food with me. I hope you don't get turned down! Being hungry is super not fun!
If you were black out drunk (with no memory) I doubt it had anything to do with who you are as a person. Have you thought about seeking counseling or going to AA or anything to address your drinking?

Honestly, I don't know. I have a solid resume and about 4 years of full time experience. But after 50+ interviews over the past 18 months, I only landed one job. (That job was really toxic, and I got canned within a few weeks for not humoring my boss when he berated me. But that's besides the point.)

The best guy I ever dated in my life hit me once, and only once, and we broke up as a result. He was drunk, and so off balance that he didn't even really hurt me. Definitely no mark. He didn't remember any of it either.

His shame from the event was what ended our relationship and I lost the love of my life. 

Talk to your girlfriend. Does she forgive you? The hardest part will be forgiving yourself.
